opportunities.title: British Council Springboard Programme 2027 for UK-Spain Research Partnerships
opportunities.programme_dates: 2027 activities; includes a two-day bilateral springboard meeting and optional research placements of up to one week for PhD/postdoctoral early-career researchers
opportunities.location_format: UK-Spain bilateral programme; meetings and lab placements take place in the United Kingdom or Spain
opportunities.funding: Up to GBP 10,000 per partnership; covers travel and subsistence for the two-day meeting, and travel, accommodation and meals for up to 2 Spanish and 2 UK PhD/postdoctoral early-career researchers on lab placements, plus communication-skills training
opportunities.eligibility: Joint application by directors/PIs of established UK and Spanish research laboratories/teams, with the UK partner as lead. Each team may include up to 6 early-career researchers; PhD and postdoctoral researchers are explicitly included for research placements.
opportunities.prerequisites: Cannot apply as an individual lead. Must be included in a joint UK-Spain application submitted by the UK lead PI/research centre; a Spanish PI/lab partner is required.

opportunities.title: BlueDot Impact Technical AI Safety Course

opportunities.title: Institute for Law & AI Winter Research Fellowship (EU Law), 2027
opportunities.programme_dates: 2027-02-01 to 2027-04-09; full-time, minimum 8 consecutive weeks; optional extension up to 5 weeks without mentorship to 2027-05-14
opportunities.location_format: Cambridge, United Kingdom strongly encouraged; remote arrangements considered case-by-case; mandatory Convening Week in Cambridge 2027-02-08 to 2027-02-12
opportunities.funding: Paid: GBP 1,000 per week; candidates with exceptional experience/qualifications may receive more. Fellows relocating to Cambridge receive a one-off GBP 7,000 relocation and housing payment. LawAI covers the UK visa application fee and Immigration Health Surcharge, and reimburses reasonable travel, accommodation and meal costs for Convening Week for fellows not based in Cambridge.
opportunities.category: AI governance / EU AI Act / AI law and policy / AI safety and security
opportunities.eligibility: Applicants from all countries and with varied skill sets, experience levels, and degrees of knowledge in AI, law and policy are welcome. Past fellows include PhD candidates, postdoctoral researchers, professionals transitioning into research and legal academics. Fellows must commit full-time for at least eight consecutive weeks and attend Convening Week in Cambridge.
opportunities.prerequisites: Strong interest in AI law and policy; ability to apply research abilities and legal knowledge to relevant questions; full-time commitment for at least eight weeks; attendance at Convening Week in Cambridge; any required UK work permission handled through sponsorship subject to route eligibility.

opportunities.title: BlueDot Impact Technical AI Safety Project Sprint
opportunities.programme_dates: Project-based remote course; approximately 30 hours total, with weekly project work and 1-hour expert-facilitated peer check-ins
opportunities.funding: Fully funded: official BlueDot Impact page states the course is freely available and operates on a pay-what-you-want model; no mandatory tuition, registration, platform, licence, or programme fee is stated. Accepted participants may separately apply for Rapid Grants for project compute/resources, but that optional support is not required for the Fully funded label.
opportunities.category: Technical AI safety / AI security / safety research engineering / evaluations / interpretability
opportunities.eligibility: Designed for software engineers, early researchers, Technical AI Safety course graduates, and other motivated technical applicants. Applicants should be comfortable coding through professional experience or completed projects.
opportunities.prerequisites: Comfortable coding through professional experience or completed projects. Prior Technical AI Safety course completion is preferred, not mandatory; applicants with equivalent technical AI-safety knowledge are considered.

opportunities.title: Institute for Law & AI Summer Research Fellowship (Legal Frontiers), 2027
opportunities.programme_dates: 2027-06-14 to 2027-08-20; 10 weeks, full-time; includes Convening Week in Washington, DC, 2027-06-21 to 2027-06-25
opportunities.location_format: Remote-first; optional in-person participation in Cambridge, UK or Washington, DC; mandatory Convening Week in Washington, DC
opportunities.funding: Paid: GBP 945 per week for fellows based in the EU or UK; USD 1,800 per week for fellows based in the US. Eligible travel expenses for the mandatory Washington, DC Convening Week are covered, including flights, accommodation, and meals. Admission to the 2027 Workshop on Law-Following AI in Cambridge, UK is also included with eligible travel expenses covered, including flights and accommodation.
opportunities.category: AI governance / AI law and policy / AI safety and security / advanced AI governance
opportunities.eligibility: Paid research fellowship for law students, professionals and academics. Most successful applicants have a strong legal background, but exceptional candidates from related fields including computer science are explicitly considered if they can articulate how their research can shape law and public policy for advanced AI. Past fellows include PhD candidates, postdoctoral researchers and professionals at various career stages.
opportunities.prerequisites: Full-time availability from 2027-06-14 to 2027-08-20 and ability to attend Convening Week in Washington, DC. Most successful applicants have a strong legal background and deep understanding of law/public policy in the US, EU or UK, but exceptional computer-science candidates and applicants without that jurisdiction-specific expertise are explicitly considered. Technical-research applicants must arrange their own qualified technical supervisor.

opportunities.title: BlueDot Impact Frontier AI Governance
opportunities.programme_dates: Cohort-based online course; intensive option ~6 days at ~5 hours/day or part-time option ~6 weeks at ~5 hours/week; approximately 30 hours total
opportunities.funding: Fully funded: official BlueDot Impact course page states Price: Free (pay-what-you-want). No mandatory tuition, registration, platform, licence, or programme fee is stated.
opportunities.category: Frontier AI governance / AI policy / AI safety / trustworthy AI / AI standards
opportunities.eligibility: Targets technical professionals, engineers, product managers, founders, serious early-career applicants, and professionals with policy/institutional knowledge who are considering AI-governance work. Selection is competitive, with an approximately 20-25% acceptance rate.
opportunities.prerequisites: AGI Strategy course or equivalent, a high-level understanding of AI, and a bias toward action. Applicants are selected competitively; approximately 20-25% acceptance rate.
